usedFor: Todoist holds quick tasks, and GoodDay receives them as project tasks through “Create Task in Project”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist, then “Create Task in Project” in GoodDay
bestTemplate.why: A task added in Todoist shows up in the chosen GoodDay project, so planning happens in one place.

watchOut: “New Task Created in Project” is polling, so “Create Task in Project” runs after a scheduled check.
